lines: **Profession:** psychiatrist, specialist in cerebral cases, neurologist, coma, head injuries, yoga practitioner, physical instructor, professor of psychology, self-ventures, advisor in his own field.
**Education:** psychology, yoga, neurology, gymnasium, counselling, athleticism.
**Diseases:** meningitis, headache, brain tumour, brain fever, vertigo, head injury, insanity, forgetfulness, **depression**, epilepsy, Parkinson's disease, Bell's palsy, cerebral haemorrhage.
**Mode of death:** sudden, **self-undoing or suicide**, head injury.
**Marriage:** by self-efforts, personal choice.

**Profession:** financial institutions, revenue departments, economists, accountants, cashier, professor of mathematics or economics, dentist, ophthalmologist, gastroenterologist, announcer, sound engineer, receptionist, dealer in metals, jewellers, gemmologist, moneylenders.

**Education:** economics, mathematics, financial management, cost accountancy, auditing, sound/acoustic engineering, ophthalmology, dentistry, cosmetics and plastic surgery, company secretaryship, public speaking.
**Diseases:** eyes, throat, tongue, speech, teeth, oral cavity, tonsils, neck, cerebellum, cheeks, gums.
**Mode of death:** **natural death** — *"assassination if there is a common link between 2 and 8."*
**Marriage:** within the family, or through the assistance of family members.

**Profession:** ENT, communication department, print media, information centre, stage artists, journalists, news correspondents, neurologists, chest specialists, physiotherapists, anaesthetist, traders, commission agents.

**Diseases:** audio-visual sensory organs, arms, shoulders, bronchitis, breasts, respiratory system.
**Mode of death:** **sudden, due to a stroke; death while in journey.**
**Marriage:** through correspondence, or with the assistance of neighbours or the younger co-born, in a nearby place.

**Profession:** real estate, interior decorator, civil and production engineers, manufacturers, industrialists, cardiologist, lung specialists, agriculturists, veterinary doctor, timber merchants, manager, restaurants, dairy farming, builders.
**Education:** civil engineering, agriculture engineering, veterinary service, farming, automobile engineering, machinery, geography, botany, home science, cardiology, chest disease.
**Diseases:** heart, lungs, blood vessels, cardiovascular system.
**Mode of death:** due to accident, **at home**, old age, **debris**.
**Marriage:** with a near relative, with the help of the mother, with a person born at the same place.

**Profession:** stock exchange, sports organisation, arts and culture, cinema, places of amusement, manufacturing of children's toys, paediatrician, gynaecologist, general physicians, nuclear scientists, atomic energy department, religion teachers, pundits, allergist.
**Education:** atomic energy, nuclear science, arts and sports, music, architecture, gynaecology, paediatrics, cinematography.
**Diseases:** viral disease, **disease due to blood cells**, liver, upper abdomen, intestinal and stomach problems, diarrhoea, spinal affections, heart troubles.
**Mode of death:** during a celebration, sports activities, **delivery**; in a gambling house, stock exchange or playing field.
**Marriage:** **love marriage**; with a sportsperson or artist; may be through the mother's family.

**Profession:** public health department, chemists, repairing units in a factory, poultry farms, veterinary department, advocates, doctors, nurses, dealers in leather, labour-oriented jobs, dealers in plastics.
**Education:** textiles, chemistry, medicine, law, biology, drugs, radiology.
**Diseases:** large intestines, pancreas, **diabetes**, peptic ulcers, colic, worms, appendicitis, hernia.
**Mode of death:** sickness, **shock from separation of the partner**, over-exhaustion, out of fear.
**Marriage:** with or through a colleague, servant, cousin or subordinate.

**Education:** business management, international law, sociology, gynaecology, nephrology, sexology.
**Diseases:** urinary system, kidneys, uterus, ovaries, testicles, prostate glands, semen, venereal diseases, impotence, frigidity/sterility, menstrual disorders.
**Mode of death:** natural death, **death in combat**, at a foreign place, due to kidney failure or AIDS.
**Marriage:** legal or registered marriage; with a business partner or a known public figure.

**Education:** aeronautical engineering, space technology, religion, law, colorectal surgery, genetic disorders, **transplant of organs**, Sanskrit.
**Diseases:** **paralysis**, femoral arteries, groin, hips, swellings, diseases caused by increase of fat, blood and water, bronchitis, sciatica.

**Marriage:** legitimate second marriage; marriage with an unknown person from a distant place or family; **marriage with the younger co-born of the partner**.

**Education:** production technology, professional diseases, politics, administration.
**Diseases:** knees, spinal cord, back pain.
**Mode of death:** **at the work place, or at the place of the partner.**

**Education:** foreign language, secret arts, research.
**Diseases:** injury in the feet, left eye, heel, sole; **insomnia**, lymphatic system.
**Mode of death:** **in a hospital, at a far-off place**; may be due to involvement in secret activities, or serious illness.
**Marriage:** **with a foreigner, or at a far-off place.**
